up: Retrieve the molecules that are reported in document CHEMBL3991601. For each molecule, return its ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum development phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Order the results by ChEMBL ID ascending.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3991601' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
